main_text.head: Præfatio ad Lectorem.
main_text.p: Requiem, ne quis in idem incidat contumaciæ exemplum.

Vivus enim est Sermo Dei & efficax, & penetrantior quovis gladio ancipiti: & pertingit usque ad divisionem animæ simul ac spiritûs, compagumque & medullarum : & dijudicat cogitationes & conceptûs cordis.

page.notes: The catchword "DIS-" is the first word of the next page, printed at lower right. The date reads CIↃ IↃC LX, i.e. MDCLX (1660). Some ink spots and specks on the scan were ignored. The text is in roman type with Latin ligatures; "Ultraj." and "Mart." are in italic bold.
